import pandas as pd

# File paths for the source CSV files
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_87/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_87/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_87/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_87/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_87/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_87/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_87/training_6.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_87/training_7.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length9_87/training_9.csv"
]

# Read all source files into a list of DataFrames
dfs = [pd.read_csv(f, index_col=0) for f in source_files]

# Concatenate all DataFrames (UNION operation)
Target9_87 = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure the schema and types match the target schema exactly
Target9_87 = Target9_87.astype({
    'admit': 'int64',
    'gre': 'int64',
    'gpa': 'float64',
    'prestige': 'int64'
})

# Write the final target table to the specified path
Target9_87.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_87/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
